newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AZHARUDDIN REPRIMANDED FOR DISSENT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AZHARUDDIN REPRIMANDED FOR DISSENT.

text.p: Former Indian captain Mohammad Azharuddin has been reprimanded by International Cricket Council (ICC) match referee Barry Jarman for dissent during the fourth day of the third test against South Africa on Sunday.
Azharuddin was adjudged lbw to Shaun Pollock for two and appeared to react to abuse from Pollock on his way back to the pavilion.
Jarman, who did not question Pollock, said in a statement:"I have taken into consideration his unblemished record during 13 years in test cricket."
